description:
Reads visible achievement definitions and permanent completion bits.
Use when: loading progress or refreshing after newlyUnlocked statistics or realtime invalidation.
Not for: changing balances or revealing locked hidden achievements.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: None (read only). Does not grant anything.
Returns: {userId,revision,definitionVersion,definitions,progress,limits,serverTime}. definitions=null retains matching cached definitions; [] clears them. Scope caches to host/project/player/session. Compact progress has rewardState=complete, nullable unknown unlockedAt and no pendingReward/inboxEntryId copy. Legacy unsettled originals remain visible until verified cold settlement.
Errors: 409 STATE_CONFLICT: reconcile and retry the same key. ACHIEVEMENT_NOT_MANUAL: report the configured statistic instead. MIGRATION_REQUIRED preserves legacy reward originals for the verified cold operator; it never authorizes a replacement reward or Inbox delivery. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

definitionVersion.description: Opaque version from the matching cached snapshot; omit for full definitions

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken, sent only as Authorization Bearer

userId.description: Signed-in player UUID matching the session

name: horizon_get_achievements
